release_notes:
1. Dynamic Store-Wide Product Tracking: Automatically captures dataLayer parameters for ANY product across the store (PDP, Quick View modals, Category & Search listings, and direct catalog add-to-cart buttons).
2. Accurate Variant SKU Resolution: Accurately resolves variant SKU (e.g. BHK125-B for Steel Blue, BHK125-R for Rostrot) directly from combination mapping and DOM attributes.
3. Product Title Reliability: Corrected product title selector to reliably extract the full product name across themes (e.g. Trink und Snack Tasse).
4. Clean GA4 Schema: Removed item_id_gmc, item_id_meta, content_type, and meta_content_ids to strictly push base product ID as item_id, active combination ID as variant_id, and variant reference as sku_id.
